title: [SYNTHETIC] Contact force without cutting the housing
source: synthetic, written to mirror patterns in a private library of real requests

step3_rows.testsToBePerformed: Use an L-shaped probe on the front rows of both ports; mate to a board for the lowest beam. Test 1: 3 cycles to 0.40 mm, first and last maximum force. Test 2: full-travel curves per wafer type.

fields.additionalInformation: Wafer pattern 1-13: G-S-S-G-S-S-LS-S-S-G-S-S-G. Measure 2 ground, 2 signal and 1 low-speed wafer.
